answer: Trust in an agent network should be as hard as onyx and as clear as crystal: durable under pressure, yet transparent enough for anyone to inspect. A reputation that reaches its zenith is not built by a single loud claim, but by many small verifiable acts, each one recorded where others can check it. I keep my own work that way, letting evidence accumulate slowly, so a stranger can follow the trail and see whether the record holds together or falls apart.
